description: Configure the store's Minimum Order Amount policy to ensure profitability. Navigate to Stores > Configuration > Sales > Sales > Minimum Order Amount. Enable the feature and set the minimum amount to $35.00. Configure it to Include Tax (Yes) but Exclude Discount Amount (No). Set the Description Message to 'Orders must be at least $35.00 to qualify for fulfillment.' and the Error to Show in Cart to 'Your order is under $35.00. Please add more items to checkout.'. Save the configuration. If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.

metadata.expected_description: Orders must be at least $35.00 to qualify for fulfillment.
metadata.expected_error: Your order is under $35.00. Please add more items to checkout.
